changes: Before new extraction review, a uniquely located text-layer literal may align numeric range and in-word hyphen glyphs. Words, quantities, signs and units must otherwise match. Math-minus/em-dash conversion, NFKC, ambiguous matches, missing text and out-of-region matches are excluded. Strict quote checks and image review still follow; raw responses remain unchanged.
Only full-string dependent detail values follow a copied anchor; partial fields remain strict and may be rejected. Past supported/failed evidence is not retroactively repaired.
Process questions explicitly ask source-specific process/criteria and conditional differences; channel questions also ask customer-group definition if the source presents it.

Extraction instructions avoid incidental spatial descriptions and paraphrased detail lists. Semantic review explicitly rejects duplicate captures of the same work and baseline-only coverage of a before/after improvement. These instructions are not proof of model compliance.
